recommendations.empty: No recommendations yet; the app shows its built-in texts.
recommendations.intro: These show in the home screen's "Today's recommendations" card. Each belongs to a phase and can be narrowed to sub-phases or to a logged symptom. Deactivate one to hide it; with no rows left the app falls back to its built-in texts.

recommendations.subphasesHint: Narrow the recommendation to part of the chosen phase. With none selected it shows in every sub-phase of that phase.
recommendations.triggerHint: Shows only on days the user logged this symptom.

languages.confirmDelete: Delete this language with all its translation files and smart messages? This can't be undone.
languages.copyFromHint: All UI strings are copied from this language so the app works in the new one right away; translate them one by one under "Translations".
languages.isDefaultHint: The default language is always active, required in content forms and the fallback for untranslated strings.
languages.regenerateHint: Copies strings added to the app since from another language. Translations you wrote are overwritten, so use it only to start over.
